executive_summary: Your supply chain is operationally stable across all pillars, but geopolitical concentration risk is the substantive issue beneath the GREEN rating. Five suppliers—two EMS vendors (Huizhou BYD, Smoore) and three material suppliers (Porton, IP Sun, EVE Energy)—all face identical US-China trade and Taiwan exposure; a tariff escalation or semiconductor export control tightening would hit all simultaneously. Separately, Infineon's unexplained 6% stock drop warrants a 48-hour check-in with their investor relations or your account team to confirm no production disruption; it's low probability but high impact given their role as a critical EE component source. In the near term, focus on Infineon clarity and map secondary sources for your China-critical EMS and battery categories—not because failure is imminent, but because your risk is concentrated rather than distributed. The South Africa (Sappi) and Nordic (Stora Enso) substrate suppliers present slower-burn risks and can be monitored on standard quarterly cycles.
